name: Irudica
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Irudica, the fierce red-haired spirit dwelling in a whirlwind in Croatian folklore.
ANATOMY: ONE adult female spirit, one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs completely hidden under a CLOSED fully opaque ankle-length tattered black gown with opaque dark leggings beneath. Long vivid RED HAIR whipping horizontally. Fierce wild glare with bared ordinary teeth, no horns or wings. [irudica-c04,irudica-c06]
MOMENT: SURGE toward the viewer as the leading edge of a thunderstorm, twist at the waist inside a powerful spinning whirlwind. She defiantly looks toward us, fierce and dangerous, never frightened or shielding her face. Arms angled to balance, no spellcasting gesture.
POWER: A VERY VISIBLE dense funnel-shaped spinning column of saltwater spray, dust and flying pebbles circles her fully covered lower body, narrows toward the sea rocks below, and coils in broad continuous physical bands around her. The whirlwind is her dwelling [irudica-c01], she leads heavy thunderstorms [irudica-c07]. Behind and to one side, a branching thunderbolt descends FROM THE SKY chasing her, hitting a rock behind her. Lightning is God's pursuit of her, NEVER emitted from her hands/body. [irudica-c05]
SCALE & CAMERA: close full figure, slightly low camera with NO upskirt view; face, red hair and recognizable funnel together fill most of frame, no invented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: single dominant distant lightning flash through black thunderclouds, deep walnut shadows and sharp rim light through spray.
SURFACE: heavy wet opaque cloth, soaked red hair strands, rough limestone, white salt spray and dark suspended grit.
SETTING: rocky Dalmatian Hvar coast under thunderclouds. [irudica-c05,irudica-c10]
MOOD: violent and uncanny storm spirit actively advancing, visibly dangerous rather than ordinary woman in weather.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no bare thighs, knees or hips; no parted skirt or lifted hem; no aura, magic glow, text, lettering, logo, border, frame, watermark, extra limbs or fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime design; no nudity or gore.
depicted_variant: Fierce red-haired Irudica rides visibly inside a spinning coastal whirlwind; pursuing lightning strikes behind her.

visual_requirements.description: Female spirit with long red hair; all legs hidden under closed opaque gown.
Dense clearly visible spinning whirlwind surrounding lower body; storm front leads with spirit while external lightning pursues her from sky.

aura: Distinctive anatomy irudica-c04,irudica-c06 and documented action irudica-c01,irudica-c05,irudica-c07.
artistic_choices: Closed ankle-length dark gown and opaque leggings are editorial modest clothing, never split or lifted.
Human female presentation follows Salome identity c04; long red hair c06 is the distinctive documented trait.
Visible spray/dust vortex literalizes dwelling in whirlwind c01, not an aura; fierce expression interprets evil spirit c01.
No giant scale or invented supernatural anatomy; external lightning is pursuit c05, never her weapon.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

rejected_attempts.reason: Redraw Irudica as the storm spirit, not a frightened ordinary woman: a visible spinning whirlwind column of spray, dust and debris that she rides or that wraps her lower body (irudica-c01), leading a thunderstorm (c07) while God's lightning hunts her across the Dalmatian/Hvar coast (c05/c10). Make her expression wild and fierce rather than scared, and keep long red hair (c06) as the identifying trait. Keep the tattered dark gown fully covering the legs, with no upskirt low angle and no bare thigh, and do not show her creating the lightning. No aura, text or gore.

visual_review.notes: Native 1254 and 200px inspected: fierce red-haired spirit dominates, both arms visible, closed fully opaque dark gown hides legs; distinct continuous salt-spray and debris vortex narrows down to rocks around lower body c01; external sky lightning pursues from behind c05 and thunderstorm c07 over coast c10. No bare thigh, frightened expression, magic-casting, text, gore or aura. Seven Sangar checks pass. Claude rejection preserved in archive.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and native crops of the face, both hands, the lower body/vortex and the lightning. One female spirit: one head, two eyes, two arms, long vivid red hair streaming sideways (red hair behind the name Rudica, irudica-c06; Salome identity, c04), and a fierce snarl with bared teeth, no longer the frightened ordinary woman of attempt-01. A dense spiral of salt spray, grit and flying pebbles winds in continuous bands around her lower body and narrows down to the limestone rocks, so she clearly rides and dwells in the whirlwind (c01) at the front of a black thunderstorm (c07). A branching bolt comes down from the clouds behind her and strikes the coast, the lightning that pursues her (c05); none of it comes from her body. The setting is a rocky Dalmatian/Hvar shore (c10). The tattered black gown is closed and opaque, and the lower body dissolves into the vortex with no thigh or leg exposed, so the r02 bare-thigh/upskirt problem is gone. The hands are small and foreshortened (left: thumb and three visible fingers; right: curled fingers), and neither is malformed. She is dominant and dangerous at 200px, with no text, aura, spellcasting gesture or borrowed design.
